verdict.rationale: Reducto's Parse endpoint explicitly extracts figures and layout alongside text/tables (reducto-docs-1), and 'agentic modes' offer advanced chart extraction with custom prompts (reducto-docs-13), while Citations return bounding-box coordinates tying extracted values back to source page positions (reducto-docs-11, reducto-docs-22). This suggests figure/chart handling with traceable positions, but the evidence doesn't explicitly confirm VLM-generated natural-language summaries of figures nor independent validation of bounding-box accuracy specifically for charts/images. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of VLM-generated figure/chart summaries, and independent/hands-on confirmation that figure positions are reliably traceable.
